readout_other: EMG mean absolute value; LFP peak value
direction_notes: EMG mean absolute value and LFP peak value evoked by TUS increased with ultrasound intensity; a fuzzy controller adjusted intensity to track target EMG/LFP values.
safety_notes: Mechanical index and temperature rise are given only in supplementary table S1.

exposures.label: closed-loop TUS of mouse motor cortex, 500 kHz

timing.protocol_description: Stimulation duration 400 ms, PRF 1 kHz, duty cycle 50%, stimulation interval 10 s; ultrasound intensity adjusted stimulus by stimulus by a fuzzy, PID or immune feedback controller using EMG or LFP feedback.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty C57BL male mice were used in the experiments (body weights 20–25 g, Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology Co., Ltd China).

flags.reason: Burst rule: DC 50% / PRF 1 kHz implies 0.5 ms pulses, so the 400 ms 'stimulation duration' is the train; pulse duration not stated.
Pressure range is tied to generator voltage (350-750 mVpp) and described as sound pressure; domain not stated (hydrophone field map in a water tank was also described).
20 mice used for the open-loop and model experiments; 10 of them in closed-loop runs, plus six additional chemically deafened mice.
Isppa and Ispta are given only in supplementary table S1, not in the main text.
No sham or control sonication arm; controllers (fuzzy, PID, immune) are compared.
